source_cards.title: Ge 2015: mouse Piezo1 trimer architecture and apparent native-gel mass
source_cards.primary_anchor: Results Piezo1 forms a homotrimer, Fig.1; cloning and purification Methods
source_cards.access_scope: Publisher full main text and Methods read; no raw EM images/gels reanalysed.

conditions.construct: Full-length 2547-aa mouse Piezo1; HEK293T expression; GST-cleaved and Flag-tagged forms compared with GST fusion.
conditions.preparation: C12E10 detergent for final cryo-EM; extraction and purification at4°C. This temperature is not a native-cell assay condition.

source_cards.observational_unit: Purified tagged/cleaved protein complexes; native-gel apparent size and EM particle symmetry.
source_cards.finding: Tag-free/Flag material has an approximately900kDa native-gel band; particle symmetry supports a trimer. GST-associated dimer-of-trimers and detergent-dependent migration caution against equating a gel band to exact peptide mass.
source_cards.limits: Architecture supports a stoichiometric factor under stated constructs, not an exact human MCF7 860370Da intact glycoprotein measurement. Structural topology interpretation was revised by later higher-resolution work.

source_cards.reported_uncertainty: No numerical uncertainty assigned to the approximate900kDa band; cryo-EM resolution4.8Å is not population SD.

source_cards.title: Guo and MacKinnon 2017: closed mouse Piezo1 dome and conditional area change
source_cards.primary_anchor: Membrane-curving properties; Fig.7 and discussion; expression/EM Methods
source_cards.access_scope: Europe PMC full JATS article; selected Results/Fig.5/7/Methods read. Publisher empty response and PMC challenge are retained as failed retrievals.

conditions.construct: Mouse Piezo1 E2JF22, GFP cleaved; BacMam expression in HEK293S GnTI−; digitonin purification.
conditions.preparation: Purification4°C; grid freezing at room temperature. POPE:POPG3:1 and POPC:DOPS:cholesterol8:1:1 weight-ratio vesicles demonstrate deformation.
conditions.state: Closed structural conformation, not measured closed fraction of native channels.

source_cards.observational_unit: Cryo-EM structure and reconstituted membrane geometry; an idealized dome used for mechanistic calculations.
source_cards.finding: Opening diameter≈18nm, depth≈6nm. The idealized membrane midplane has curvature radius10.2nm, area400nm² and projected area280nm²; complete flattening would give120nm² projected-area change. These quantities differ from protein-only lipid exclusion and a drag-equivalent center radius.
source_cards.limits: The projection change is conditional, not a measured gating increment. Missing N-terminal helices and idealized geometry remain explicit. Neither10nm scalar hydrodynamic radius nor100nm² exclusion is calibrated here. The proposed lateral-tension mechanism does not measure a normal insertion spring.

document_anchors.description: Conditional areas and proposed lateral-tension mechanism

source_cards.reported_uncertainty: Approximate structural/model dimensions, not a biological radius band or uncertainty on current inputs.

source_cards.title: UniProt Q92508: canonical human sequence mass field
source_cards.access_scope: Official REST JSON read at captured retrieval time; sequence, organism, entry audit and glycosylation annotations inspected.
source_cards.observational_unit: Canonical sequence record, not isolated native-channel weighing.
source_cards.finding: The saved record reports2521aa and286790Da. Three copies give860370Da exactly as declaration arithmetic. This combines the human sequence mass field with a homotrimer assumption; it is not the same observation as the mouse native-gel band.
source_cards.limits: Glycosylation annotations exist at human positions295 and2294. Their occupied glycoforms, other modifications, isoforms and associated lipids are not quantified here. Sequence-derived scope does not define the intact MCF7 channel mass distribution.

source_cards.title: Haselwandter and MacKinnon 2018: protein intersection versus membrane footprint
source_cards.primary_anchor: System of Piezo plus membrane, Fig.1; Shape and energy of membrane footprint
source_cards.access_scope: Europe PMC full JATS article; system definition, Fig.1 and Results/Methods inspected. No source calculation executed.

conditions.source_geometry: Mouse structure6B3R from Guo2017 reused; spherical-cap approximation.
conditions.model_conditions: Dome area390nm², curvature radius10.2nm; illustrative Kb20kBT and tension0.1kBT/nm². These are source-model settings, not current measured inputs.

source_cards.observational_unit: Intersection of a model membrane midplane with a partial protein structure and calculated surrounding membrane deformation.
source_cards.finding: About20% of the dome midplane is protein and80% lipid. Conditional arithmetic20%×390nm²≈78nm² describes that approximate intersection; it does not establish current100nm² exclusion. The membrane footprint is deformed lipid membrane outside the dome, not protein-occupied area.
source_cards.limits: The390 versus earlier400nm² values are approximations, not independent paired measurements. The footprint uses the same Guo structure and depends on membrane mechanics. No drag radius, initial occupancy or normal spring is measured by this theory.

document_anchors.description: 20/80 coverage, external footprint and390nm² model area

source_cards.reported_uncertainty: Approximate coverage and model inputs; no empirical population uncertainty or new independent geometry study inferred.

source_cards.title: NIST CODATA2022: atomic mass constant
source_cards.primary_anchor: Atomic mass constant numerical value and standard uncertainty
source_cards.access_scope: Official NIST constants page bytes and value table read.
source_cards.observational_unit: Physical unit conversion, not channel material measurement.
source_cards.finding: NIST gives1.66053906892(52)×10−27kg. Since1kg=10^15pg, the central value gives1Da=1.66053906892×10−12pg, matching the frozen conversion.
source_cards.limits: The kg-valued atomic mass constant has stated metrological uncertainty; it is not an exact SI defining constant. Its small uncertainty does not supply a biological mass prior.
source_cards.reported_uncertainty: Standard uncertainty5.2×10−37kg, relative3.1×10−10; retained only as metrological context.

source_code_anchors.interpretation: Population append is conditional on enabled input; reads preparation fractions and mass/radius/excluded-area declarations. This caller explicitly does not turn on gating chemistry. Literal enabled=0 only describes this template if used without override and reached.
Caller copies positions, material/protein masses, radii, IDs and face support; it does not copy plan[state] into these returned tables. No assertion about every external caller or actual run is made.

N=floor(density*sum(triangle areas)+0.5). Valid C/O/I probabilities drive finite categorical draws, not exact realised fractions. Faces are area-weighted and positions barycentric. Read as text only; no RNG or model executed.

Excluded lipid mass per channel=excluded_lipid_area*lipid_areal_density, removed from host-face nodes by barycentric weights; positive masses required. Protein mass uses Da-to-pg conversion, radius is copied independently. No disk-area=pi*radius^2 relation is declared.
When channel_insertion exists, normal insertion coefficient is passed to SurfaceInsertion. Reading this adapter does not verify a native active path.

Declared energy is one-half k times squared distance to the current material surface. Pure normal force on triangle interiors; edge/vertex normal-cone and nonsmooth-switch qualifications preserved. This is confinement, not a source-measured Piezo gating stiffness.
Static kernel text assigns E=.5*k*distance_squared and equal/opposite center/face forces. No runtime import or execution; no validation authority claimed.

Source module distinguishes empty C/O/I states from species-occupied open states and explicitly calls the single-occupancy pore an exploratory mechanism. Population geometry is not proof this chemistry is connected.
Exact Boltzmann constant unit conversion gives kBT in pN·um from cell.temperature. This supports only the stated scalar energy illustration, not a runtime temperature observation.
